scale_weight_sweep.formula: P = w * mean(P1024_original, inverse_flip(P1024_flip)) + (1-w) * mean(P768_original, inverse_flip(P768_flip)); continuous probabilities resized before combination

endpoint_equivalence.0.5: Legacy equal four-view sequential sum then /4

scale_weight_sweep.selection_rule: Maximize aggregate validation mIoU across all candidate weights; ties within 1e-12 prefer larger 1024 weight

crater_score_adjustment: Only final class-2 probability multiplied by gamma before argmax; one global factor
mountain_score_adjustment: Only mountain probability multiplied by alpha after final resize, before argmax; not a threshold
protocol: Independent scene confusion matrices, GT-present class mean; sizes [1024, 768], original + horizontal flip at each size, validation 1024-weight sweep [1.0, 0.75, 0.5]; no label postprocessing
